agents.description: Reviews a contract document for regulatory compliance risk and issues a verdict.

steps.name: assessClean
steps.description: Record a nil risk assessment for documents with no flagged clauses.

steps.name: assessRisk
steps.description: Score the regulatory risk implied by the flagged clauses.

steps.name: issueVerdict
steps.description: Issue the final compliance verdict from the risk assessment.
examples: Review this vendor contract for EU compliance risk

steps.name: retentionPeriodLookup
steps.description: Look up the retention period in years mandated for a given jurisdiction.
steps.llmToolDescription: Look up the retention period in years mandated for a given jurisdiction.

steps.name: screenClauses
steps.description: Extract and flag clauses containing high-risk contractual terms.

agents.description: Evaluates user-generated content against platform policies and issues a moderation decision.

steps.name: analyzeContent
steps.description: Analyse user-generated content for toxicity and policy violations.

steps.name: autoTag
steps.description: Automatically tag content that is clearly clean or clearly violating policy.

steps.name: deepReview
steps.description: Perform a deeper contextual review of ambiguous or borderline content.

steps.name: recordDecision
steps.description: Record the final moderation decision based on the tagged content.

agents.description: Preprocesses, analyses, and summarises a document. Demonstrates default-producer action for optional inputs, Ai injection, value, canRerun, and full @AchievesGoal options.

steps.name: analyzeContent
steps.description: Deep content analysis: tone, themes, structure, quality score.

steps.name: extractMetadata
steps.description: Extract metadata (topics, keywords, reading time) from the cleaned document. Guided by MetadataHints.

steps.name: preprocessDocument
steps.description: Normalise and clean the raw document content.

steps.name: provideDefaultMetadataHints
steps.description: Provide default metadata extraction hints when the caller did not supply any.

steps.name: summarizeDocument
steps.description: Generate the final document summary with key points and recommended action.
examples: Process and analyse this technical document
Extract key points from the attached whitepaper

agents.description: Screens financial transactions for fraud and produces an approve/block/review decision.

steps.name: decideFraud
steps.description: Issue a final fraud decision based on the pattern screening result.

steps.name: enrichContext
steps.description: Enrich the transaction with derived risk signals (high-value, cross-border, unusual hour).

steps.name: screenForPatterns
steps.description: Screen the enriched transaction for known fraud patterns using LLM analysis.

agents.description: Screens a customer against risk indicators and produces a risk assessment.

steps.name: assessDirectRisk
steps.description: Assess overall KYC risk for direct cases and produce a recommendation.

steps.name: assessRiskWithEnhancedDueDiligence
steps.description: Assess overall KYC risk after enhanced due diligence.

steps.name: collectEnhancedDueDiligence
steps.description: Collect enhanced due diligence notes for PEP or adverse-media cases.

steps.name: screenCustomer
steps.description: Screen customer data against PEP lists, sanctions databases, and adverse media.

agents.description: Assesses the credit risk of a loan application and produces an approve, reject or refer decision.

steps.name: analyzeCreditProfile
steps.description: Analyse the applicant's credit profile, compute a debt-to-income ratio and affordability score.

steps.name: conductUnderwriting
steps.description: Conduct a manual underwriting assessment for borderline loan applications.

steps.name: makeAutoDecision
steps.description: Make an automatic lending decision for clearly creditworthy or clearly unqualified applicants.

steps.name: makeUnderwrittenDecision
steps.description: Make a lending decision for a borderline application after a full underwriting assessment.

agents.description: Researches a product category using market data and competitive analysis, guided by an LLM supervisor.

steps.name: analyzeCompetitors
steps.description: Analyze the competitive landscape for the product category — only runs when market data confidence is sufficient.

steps.name: generateReport
steps.description: Generate the final consolidated research report from available market and competitive data.
examples: Research the electric vehicle market in the US
Analyze the smartwatch market in APAC

steps.name: supervisor
steps.description: Supervisor action that orchestrates tools to achieve the goal

steps.name: gatherMarketData
steps.description: Gather high-level market size, growth rate, and trend data for the requested product category.

agents.description: Screens candidate resumes against a job position and produces a hiring recommendation.

steps.name: analyzeResume
steps.description: Analyse the candidate's resume for technical skills, years of experience and relevance to the role.

steps.name: assessCultureFit
steps.description: Assess the candidate's culture fit and values alignment from the cover letter.

steps.name: makeHiringDecision
steps.description: Combine the resume analysis and culture-fit score to produce a final hiring recommendation.

agents.description: Analyses customer feedback sentiment and routes it to an auto-response or an escalation path.

steps.name: deepAnalyze
steps.description: Perform a deep analysis of the feedback to identify root causes, emotional tone, and actionable insights.

steps.name: quickClassify
steps.description: Quickly classify the sentiment of the customer feedback (POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL/MIXED).

steps.name: respondToCustomer
steps.description: Generate a customer-facing response and recommended support action based on the full analysis.

agents.description: Iteratively drafts, reviews, and revises short stories until editorial quality is achieved.

steps.name: draftStatus
steps.description: Returns a one-line status summary for the given draft, including title, word count, and revision number.
steps.llmToolDescription: Returns a one-line status summary for the given draft, including title, word count, and revision number.

steps.name: draftStory
steps.description: Write the first draft of the story according to the request parameters.

steps.name: finalizeStory
steps.description: Assemble the final approved story from the accepted draft and review.
examples: Write a mystery story about redemption
Write a 500-word sci-fi story on the theme of loneliness

steps.name: reviewDraft
steps.description: Critically review the current draft and decide if it is ready to finalize or needs revision.

steps.name: reviseDraft
steps.description: Revise the story draft according to the editorial review feedback.

agents.description: Routes and resolves customer support tickets by category using Utility AI planning and state-based handlers.

steps.name: classifyTicket
steps.description: Classify the support ticket into billing, technical, or general category with an urgency score.

steps.name: handleBilling
steps.description: Handle the billing ticket: generate response template and escalation guidance.

steps.name: handleGeneral
steps.description: Handle the general enquiry: generate an informative response template.
examples: How do I update my profile?
Where can I find your pricing?

steps.name: handleTechnical
steps.description: Handle the technical ticket: generate debugging steps and escalation guidance.

steps.name: Nirvana
steps.description: Nirvana: Nothing more to do

steps.name: routeToCategory
steps.description: Route the classified ticket to the appropriate category-specific state handler.
